meta.studyIn: Study in {country} from Nepal: Cost & Visa
meta.destinationsDesc: Compare studying in the UK, Australia, Canada, USA, New Zealand, Cyprus and Japan from Nepal: costs, work rights, intakes and visas.
meta.aboutDesc: St. Xavier Educational Network is a study abroad consultancy in Kathmandu guiding Nepali students since 2012.
meta.teamDesc: Meet the St. Xavier counsellors who guide students to the UK, Australia, Canada, USA, New Zealand, Cyprus and Japan.
meta.contactDesc: Call, WhatsApp, email or visit St. Xavier Educational Network in Kathmandu for free study abroad counselling.
meta.parentsDesc: Safety, total costs, education loans and support after arrival — what Nepali parents should know before a child studies abroad.
meta.testPrep: IELTS, PTE & Japanese Classes in Kathmandu
meta.testPrepDesc: IELTS, PTE, TOEFL and Japanese language classes in Kathmandu with small batches, flexible timings and free mock tests.
meta.servicesDesc: Counselling, mock tests, test preparation and test registration for Nepali students planning to study abroad.
meta.toolsDesc: Free study abroad tools for Nepali students: eligibility checker, cost calculator, scholarship finder, IELTS calculator and more.
meta.successStoriesDesc: Real stories from Nepali students who got their offers and visas with St. Xavier Educational Network.
meta.universitiesDesc: Search universities in the UK, Australia, Canada, USA, New Zealand, Cyprus and Japan by country, field, intake and tuition.
meta.blogDesc: Visa updates, scholarships, test prep tips and student-life guides for Nepali students planning to study abroad.
meta.eventsDesc: University fairs, info sessions and free webinars on studying abroad from Nepal.
meta.webinarsDesc: Join live webinars or watch recordings on studying in the UK, Australia, Canada, USA, Japan and more.
meta.faqDesc: Answers to common questions about studying abroad from Nepal: costs, visas, tests, scholarships and our services.
meta.bookDesc: Book a free study abroad counselling session at our Kathmandu office, on Zoom or by WhatsApp call.
meta.enquiryDesc: Tell us what you need in a few quick steps and a St. Xavier counsellor will contact you.
